problems.headline: After-hours calls are not answered the same day.
problems.evidence: GBP hours end early evening; no after-hours line or chat on the site.

problems.headline: You do not promise a same-day callback; nearby PI firms do.
problems.evidence: No speed-to-lead claim on site; local competitors advertise faster response.

problems.headline: Buying ads now would pour leads into the same gap.
problems.evidence: No clear LSA or ads running — fix intake before spending on demand.

problems.headline: No online intake form — every lead requires a phone call.
problems.evidence: Website has no contact form or chat; only a phone number listed.

problems.headline: Google Business Profile has no reviews in the last 6 months.
problems.evidence: Last review is from January; competitors have 10+ recent reviews.

problems.headline: Practice area pages are thin and don’t target local keywords.
problems.evidence: Service pages under 200 words; no mention of Brooklyn or surrounding areas.

problems.headline: Website is not available in Spanish despite a bilingual market.
problems.evidence: No language toggle; competitors offer full Spanish-language sites.

problems.headline: No FAQ or resource section to capture informational search traffic.
problems.evidence: Zero blog posts or guides; missing common immigration-question keywords.

problems.headline: Consultation booking requires email back-and-forth, not self-service.
problems.evidence: No calendar widget; contact page says ‘we will get back to you.’

problems.headline: No trust or will pricing transparency — visitors leave to compare.
problems.evidence: Competitors list starting prices; your site says ‘call for a quote.’

problems.headline: GBP category is ‘Lawyer’ instead of ‘Estate planning attorney.’
problems.evidence: Generic category hurts ranking for estate-specific searches.

problems.headline: Site loads in 6+ seconds on mobile — half of visitors bounce.
problems.evidence: PageSpeed score 38; unoptimized images and render-blocking scripts.
